strings.Add one or more links (Ctrl+N): Faʻaopopo se tasi pe sili atu fesoʻotaʻiga (Ctrl+N)
strings.Select every download in this list (clic: Faʻavasega uma faʻapipiʻiga i lenei lisi (kiliki e toe faʻavasega)
strings.Remove the selected downloads from the l: Toe faʻapipiʻi le faila i le lisi
strings.Stop the selected queue: Faʻatali mo le taimi e filifili ai
strings.Download files from a website section: Faʻapipiʻi faila mai se vaega o le 'upega tafaʻilagi
strings.Download a numbered series of files: Faʻapipiʻi se faʻasologa o faila numeraina
strings.About Nexonic Download Manager: E uiga i le Nexonic Download Manager
strings.Time Left: Aofai o le taimi ua mavae
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: Kiliki i le Faʻaopopo URL, pe peʻe se sootaga, tuu se tasi i luga o lenei window, pe kiliki i le download mai lau browser ma le faʻaopoopoga.
strings.Show in Folder: Faʻaalia i totonu o se faila
strings.Delete and Move File to Recycle Bin…: Delete and Move File to Recycle Bin…
strings.Delete and Move File to Trash…: Suʻe ma Tuʻu le Faila i le Mamao…
strings.Same as the system: E tutusa lava ma le faiga
strings.The new language is used after the app r: O le gagana fou o le a faʻaaogaina pe a toe amataina le polokalama.
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: E faʻaaoga e faʻapipiʻi, vitio ma torrents lenei adapter (mo se faʻataʻitaʻiga lau VPN). Afai e le fesoʻotaʻi, o le a taofi le faʻapipiʻiina e aunoa ma le faʻaaogaina o se isi fesoʻotaʻiga.
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: Torrent blocklist: a file or a https:// address (empty = none)
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: Torrents e le'i feso'ota'i i tua atu o tuatusi i lenei lisi. P2P, DAT ma CIDR lisi e galue, e pei foi o.gz. E toe downloadina se tuatusi i le aso.
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: E tatau ona amataina le tuatusi o le 'blocklist' ma le https://
E leʻi maua le faila o le '%s'.
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: E faʻapipiʻiina mea fou o nei fuataga pe a fetaui o latou tifaga ma le tulafono: faila ma vitio, ma torrents pe a faʻaolaina torrents. E lisiina e se tulafono upu e tatau ona i totonu o le tifaga, poʻo se /regular expression/.
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: Faʻapipiʻi mea o loʻo i ai nei upu uma i lo latou igoa (maualuga = uma mea)
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: Ia galo mea e iai se tasi o nei upu i le igoa
strings.Check every (minutes, 15 or more): Siaki i taimi uma (minutes, 15 po o sili atu)
strings.Only download items that appear after th: Toe faʻapipiʻi mea na faʻaalia i le faʻaopoopoga o le fuataga
strings.The feed address must start with http://: E tatau ona amataina le tuatusi o le feed ma http:// po o https://
strings.The rule's regular expression is not val: O le faaupuga masani o le tulafono e le talafeagai.
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: I le taimi ou te faʻaaogaina ai le komepiuta, faʻatapulaʻa faʻapipiʻi i le KB/s (0 = faʻatapulaʻaina)
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: Saosaoa atoa pe a mavae se minute e aunoa ma se kilivaina o le mouse po o le keyboard.
strings.Your API key for the service: O lau ki API mo le auaunaga
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: Nofoaga o loʻo i ai fesoʻotaʻiga i totonu (faʻaeseʻeseina e se komi, e.g. example-host.com)
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: Faʻaola i le tulaga masani. Faʻaaoga lau lava teugatupe; e le'i tuʻuina atu ni fesoʻotaʻiga mai isi 'upega tafaʻilagi i le tautua. E teuina le ki i se auala encrypted ma e le' i teuina i se backup.
strings.Same as Windows: E tutusa lava ma le Windows
strings.Download limit reached: Ua oo i le faʻatapulaʻaina o le faʻasusu
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Faʻatapulaʻaina o le faʻapipiʻiina: i le tele o lenei MB (0 = leai se faʻatapulaʻaina)
strings.… every this many hours: … i taimi uma nei itula e tele
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: Afai ua oo i le aofaiga, o le a taofia le faʻaigoaina ma toe faʻaauau pe a amataina le vaitaimi mulimuli.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Tuʻu le tuatusi 'upega tafaʻilagi o le tusiata proxy (http:// poʻo le https://) poʻo le auala atoa i le faila).
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Proxy address (mo se script proxy: lona tuatusi 'upega tafaʻilagi po o se faila)
strings.Text, links or page address: Teugatupe, sootaga poʻo le tuatusi o le itulau
strings.Put each package in its own folder: Tuʻu soʻo se paka i lona lava faila
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Faʻasaʻo faʻamaumauga a le paka pe a maeʻa uma
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Pega se faʻamatalaga ma ni fesoʻotaʻiga, poʻo se tuatusi o se 'upega tafaʻilagi ma kiliki i luga o le 'Suʻe ni fesoʻotaʻiga'. O vaega uma o se faʻaputuga o faʻamaumauga ua vaevaeina i totonu o se pusa.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Tuʻu le ata atoa i le masini o le ata (sites e pei o le Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; o le taimi muamua lea e faʻapipiʻi ai le masini)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Faʻaola le 'Add' window i le faila na ou faʻaaogaina i le taimi ua mavae
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Faʻaola le komepiuta mai le moe e amata ai
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Faʻaaoga se taimi uaea o le Windows wake; e tatau ona faʻatagaina e le Power Options le taimia o le wake. E tatau ona taʻalo le faʻatinoga (e mafai ona i totonu o le tray).

strings.Getting the video engine (only the first: Getting the video engine (only the first time)…
